einzeiler: Countdown of the top trending songs for the week of December 11th.
kurzfassung: This episode counts down the top trending songs of the week on iHeartRadio. Paul Russell secures the fifth spot with Lil Boo Thang. Tate McRae takes the number one position with her hit Greedy.
stichpunkte: Paul Russell enters at number five with Lil Boo Thang
Miley Cyrus holds the fourth position with Used to Be Young
Taylor Swift rises back to number three with Cruel Summer
Doja Cat moves down to the second spot with Paint the Town Red
Tate McRae claims the number one song of the week with Greedy
